decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 
20(1)	The approved acoustic barrier/fence shall have a height of 3.5m above the adjacent ground level.	

Reason: In order that the Local Planning Authority may be satisfied as to the details of the development, to safeguard the amenities of adjoining residential properties, in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New development), ENV-P.1.5 (Noise Pollution), of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.
description: Following approval for the demolition of the existing building and erection of three new buildings and associated parking and landscaping with flexible permission for use as a motor vehicle hire centre (sui generis) and B1(c), B2 and B8 uses with ancillary office space for Unit A (occupying the southern part of site) and B1(c), B2 and B8 uses with ancillary office space for Units B and C (occupying the centre and northern part of the site) details submitted pursuant to Condition 20 (Acoustic Barrier) of approved planning permission 00229/P/P25 dated 19/2/08
